title: Citroën Ami
summary: Stellantis's L6e quadricycle launched 2020; 65,000+ units sold worldwide, market leader of the modern French micro-EV segment, sales hit by removal of the bonus écologique.

title: Fiat Topolino
summary: Stellantis's Italian-styled twin of the Ami, same Moroccan-built platform; sales up 53% in 2025 to 6,853 units, 40% of Italy's L6e segment.

title: Microlino
summary: Swiss-designed, Turin-built isetta-inspired L6e pod; design-icon status but commercially struggling against Stellantis pricing — ~3,700 units produced in 2024.

title: La Bagnole (Kilow)
summary: Made-in-France L6e/L7e buggy from Haute-Savoie startup Kilow; aluminium bodywork, 283 kg, €10,800 base — targeting 1,000 units/year by 2026.

title: Mobilize Duo (Renault)
summary: Renault's would-be Twizy successor; only 1,300 units sold in H1 2025, with the Mobilize brand itself wound down after Renault's December 2025 strategic pivot.

title: Toyota FT-Me
summary: Toyota's L6e concept unveiled Brussels March 2025; aimed under €10,000 and built on Toyota's Tokyo/Paris Olympic mobility work — first major OEM at scale to enter the segment.

title: Silence S04
summary: Spanish-made L6e/L7e quadricycle (Scutum Logistic, Barcelona) distributed in France/DE/IT/UK by Nissan as part of its 'The Arc' strategy; four variants including a Cargo.

title: Paris Shared E-Bike Contract (2025)
summary: Four-year contract awarded to Voi, Dott and Lime starting October 2025; each operator deploys 3,000–6,000 bikes (up to 7,500 in peak season) — the post-scooter shared-mobility settlement for Paris.

title: Paris Rental E-Scooter Ban (2023)
summary: Free-floating rental e-scooters banned in Paris from 1 September 2023 after a citizen referendum; 15,000 vehicles withdrawn, reshaping European shared-mobility strategy.

title: Vélib' (Smovengo)
summary: Paris's municipal bike-share, run by Smovengo since 2018 — the mature template for public-contract shared mobility; over 76 million trips on shared bikes in Paris in 2025.

title: Cargo Bike Segment (France)
summary: 33,000–35,000 cargo bikes sold in France in 2024, growing even as the overall bike market dipped; shifting from family use to DHL/Amazon last-mile logistics.

title: Observatoire National de la Micromobilité
summary: Created May 2024 by the Ministry of Ecological Transition to monitor personal motorized transport — the French state formalizing micromobility as a regulated category.

title: Mobilians (Trade Body)
summary: French automotive and mobility trade association tracking the EDPM market (5 million e-scooters sold over 10 years) and shaping rules from the industry side.

title: Fluctuo
summary: Paris-based shared-mobility data analytics company; the reference data layer underpinning city decisions on operator contracts and fleet sizing.

title: TIER–Dott Merger (2024)
summary: 2024 merger of German TIER and Dutch Dott — the headline consolidation event of European shared micromobility, narrowing the operator field.

title: Bonus Écologique Removal for L6e Quadricycles
summary: The €900 purchase subsidy for L6e quadricycles was withdrawn in 2025, immediately depressing Ami sales by 19% — a textbook subsidy-dependence shock.
